description: This script contains tests for verifying the behavior of 'git fetch' with different 'tagopt' configurations, focusing on how tags are fetched or ignored based on specified options. It utilizes a testing framework defined in 'test-lib.sh' to set up repositories, configure remote options, and validate fetch outcomes by checking references.

methods.name: setup_clone
methods.description: Sets up a git mirror clone, adds remote, and creates a tag and branch for testing purposes.
